title: Goin' Coastal | KEY.co
description_expanded: Goin’ Coastal offers a refreshing blend of coastal charm and upscale comfort in the sought-after Magnolia Cottages neighborhood. With its professionally designed interiors, soaring ten-foot ceilings, and light-filled spaces, the home instantly soothes the senses. Guests are welcomed by a breezy screened-in porch perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails, and an open-concept living space featuring plush seating, a 50” Smart TV, and a chef’s kitchen with quartz countertops and premium appliances. Whether gathering around the custom dining banquette or enjoying time outdoors, this home invites connection and relaxation at every turn.
